notes: Reconnection after a reboot or an address change: the relay pinned each side's address and silently dropped a device that came back somewhere else, so two machines that rebooted never found each other again. The agent now reopens a discovery socket that has died under it instead of announcing into it every twenty seconds forever. Update channels no longer offer an older release as an update. And deploy/upgrade-edge.sh stops dirtying its own checkout, runs the release's own copy of itself, and says precisely what it did and did not upgrade.
